title: Composition of proper derived direct images on quasi-coherent complexes
statement: Let $Z$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ be proper morphisms [def-weil-proper-morphism] of finite type between Noetherian schemes. On the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] of quasi-coherent sheaves, there is a canonical natural isomorphism $R(g\circ f)_*\cong Rg_*\circ Rf_*$. The isomorphisms are unital and associative for a further proper morphism.

source.place: Tag 0ATX, Lemma 48.16.3 (composition of upper shriek), proof: the proper direct-image composition

proof.text: Proper morphisms are quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Apply [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-qcoh] to each object of D_QCoh, using its property proof, to construct p. No right adjoint of the restricted direct image is needed.

Choose the ambient comparison and its right-derived unit equation from [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image-composition] for the underlying ringed-space morphisms. Whisker with the full-subcategory inclusion to construct c. Its inverse component at the included Qh(K) is the ambient component, so the existing unit equation proves the required characterization.

Apply [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-composition-unit-laws] to the chosen ambient comparisons and their characterization. Whisker its identity comparison with each inclusion and compose with the functor right unitor. Simplification proves the two restricted unit equations. Apply [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-composition-associativity] at the underlying object E.obj to obtain the restricted triple-composition equation. The witnesses use p only for membership of the intermediate objects; proof irrelevance identifies those membership proofs.

proof_origin.note: Lean reduction using existing ambient composition and qcqs preservation, with the two coherence clauses isolated as strictly smaller theorems.
